text: Plan completed at docs/plans/surfviewjs-display-parity.md and linked from the viewer guide/recovery ledger. Independent lean_expert review accepted the proof design after adding independent fixture-input oracles, full public camera/material contracts, per-element masks, actual-backend versus product-route verdicts, and frozen required matrix rows. Twelve core display families require side-by-side PNG plates, overlays/blink, error heatmaps, semantic/pixel/resource receipts, interaction checkpoints and independent visual review. Pixel targets are proposed and must be calibrated/frozen before candidate evaluation. No fresh build/native rendering/parity qualification claimed.
